anfrage: Give me all products from the electronics category with their prices. Return product name and price in two columns.
How many students are enrolled in the Computer Science department? Return a single count.
List all appointments with Dr. Smith or Dr. Johnson. Show patient ID, doctor name, and appointment date.
Get the average temperature recorded by all sensors in the city center area. Return a single value.
Find all books published after 2020, optionally include their ISBN if available. Show book title, publication year, and ISBN.
Show me the total sales amount per product category for the last quarter. Display category name and total sales amount.
List all employees who work in the Engineering department or have a salary above 80000. Show employee name and department.
Get the top 5 most borrowed books from the library along with the number of times they were borrowed. Return book title and borrow count.

Get all movies with average rating above 3.0. Exclude movies that are marked as deleted. Return movie title and average rating.

Show all products that have never been ordered. Display product name and stock quantity.
Extract the year from publication dates and count how many articles were published each year after 2018. Show year and article count.
Find all flights from London with a layover duration. Calculate total flight time including layover. Show flight number, destination, and total time.
List all properties with their landlords. If a property has a manager, show the manager name, otherwise show the landlord name.
Find departments with more than 10 employees and average salary above 50000. Show department name, employee count, and average salary.
Show all books borrowed by members from Germany. Display book title, author, and member name.
Get all veterinary appointments scheduled in the current month for cats. Show pet name, owner name, and appointment date.

Show weather measurements where temperature exceeds 30 degrees or humidity is below 20 percent. Display station name, temperature, humidity, and measurement date.
Calculate total delivery time for each courier and count their deliveries. Show courier name, total deliveries, and average delivery time for couriers with more than 5 deliveries.
Find events attended by participants from at least 3 different cities. Show event name and participant count.
List all train tickets for first-class passengers traveling to Berlin. Show passenger name, ticket price, departure date, and a price category (Budget/Standard/Premium based on price).
Find all restaurants with vegan options and a rating of at least 4 stars. Show restaurant name, cuisine type, and rating.
Get insurance claims filed in 2024 with approved status. Show policyholder name, claim amount, and approval date.
Calculate total energy production per plant type in kWh. Show plant type and sum of energy produced, only for plant types producing more than 100000 kWh. Ensure all measurements are in kWh.
Combine all customer information from both online store and retail store databases. Show customer name and email from both sources.
Get a complete list of all employees including both full-time and part-time workers. Show employee name and position from both employment types.

Find all research publications from 2020 onwards, including both journal articles (with impact factor) and conference papers (with conference name). Show title, year, publication type, and either impact factor or conference name.

Find all premium customers who have made orders since January 2024 with products from the 'Electronics' category, where those products have an average review rating above 4 stars. Show customer name, order date, product name, product price, review rating, and shipping status. Only include orders with completed payment that are either shipped or delivered.
